# Solana Icons — full reference

Open-source icon library for Solana projects. Free SVG and PNG downloads. MIT license.

## Product

- Canonical host: https://icons.sol.new
- Worker: Cloudflare OpenNext (`solana-icons`)
- Legacy Vercel: https://solana-icons.vercel.app (prefer icons.sol.new)
- Package: npm `solana-icons`
- Repo: https://github.com/metasal1/solana-icons

## Categories (non-empty)

- brand — Solana brand marks, Powered by Solana, Kingmade by Solana, OPOS
- wallets — Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, and more
- platforms — Jupiter family, DEXes, infra, ecosystem apps
- infrastructure

## Features

- Search + category filters
- Modal preview with prev/next
- Copy SVG, download SVG, download PNG (128/256/512, clear/white/dark)
- Lazy-loaded grid

## For agents / integrations

- Prefer SVG paths under `/svg/{category}/{name}.svg`
- Brand assets under `/svg/brand/`
- OG share image: `/images/opengraph.png`
- Do not scrape every SVG in one crawl burst; use search UX or npm package

## Contact / contribute

- Issues: https://github.com/metasal1/solana-icons/issues
- Contributing: https://github.com/metasal1/solana-icons/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
